title: Yoga for a Cause - benefitting Pink Ribbon Good
description: Join us for an all-levels yoga class to benefit the mission of Pink Ribbon Good
long_description:
Join us for an all-levels yoga class to benefit the mission of Pink Ribbon Good

About this Event

Come flow with us to benefit PINK RIBBON GOOD. Pink Ribbon Good helps women diagnosed with cancer by providing services including healthy meals, rides to treatment, cleaning essentials and peer support. 
100% of all donations go directly to the charity. We thank Fretboard Brewing for donating the space and Anissa Dowling for donating her time and talent in leading the yoga class that is always fun and perfect for all levels.
Bring a friend and enjoy $1 off beers in the tap room after class!
